messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "treatment may include exercise"
set: ["treatment may include exercise", "treatment may include diet", "treatment may include weight control", "treatment may include blood tests", "your treatment may include a special diet", "your treatment may also include counseling or other treatments", "exercise", "no exercise", "your treatment may also include diet, exercise, weight control, and blood tests", "include rifampin", "diet and exercise", "may interfere with diabetes treatment", "your treatment may also include diet, exercise, weight control, medical tests, and special medical care", "gallbladder problems include nausea", "gallbladder problems include jaundice", "gallbladder problems include fever"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
